## What changes

Describe the learner-facing problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Simulator or browser behavior checked when the change affects the 3D lab

## Boundaries

- [ ] No generated simulator assets, ONNX policies, learning profiles, or secrets are included
- [ ] Simulator-only and hardware-unverified behavior is labelled clearly
